investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Brightus Trips (travel booking); Platform: Microsoft Azure westeurope (zones westeurope-1/westeurope-2/westeurope-3); network range 10.227.0.0/16; Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-02, maxmemory 16gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the inventory-sync PostgreSQL database inventory-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
